extracted.intended_audience: authors and researchers preparing and reporting randomized trials (trialists), journal editors, and peer reviewers
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for preparing randomized trial protocols and reporting trial results using SPIRIT (protocol reporting; 34-item checklist) and CONSORT (results reporting; 30-item checklist) statements and associated materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPIRIT Statement (protocol reporting)
rubrics_metrics.description: The SPIRIT (Standard Protocol Items: Recommendations for Interventional Trials) Statement is a minimum set of recommendations for reporting the protocol of a randomised trial. The recommendations are outlined in a 34-item checklist and a figure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the 34-item checklist and figure to ensure trial protocols are reported completely and transparently so readers can critically appraise, interpret and use the research. The site provides Checklist, Expanded checklist, Figure, and the full Statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use SPIRIT with Explanation and Elaboration
rubrics_metrics.description: We strongly recommend using the SPIRIT Statement in conjunction with the 'Explanation and Elaboration' document.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Explanation and Elaboration explains and illustrates the principles underlying the SPIRIT Statement; consult it for examples, rationale and detailed guidance on how to implement each checklist item.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT Statement (results reporting)
rubrics_metrics.description: The CONSORT (CONsolidated Standards Of Reporting Trials) Statement is an evidence-based, minimum set of recommendations for reporting the results of randomised trials. The recommendations are outlined in a 30-item checklist and a flow diagram.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the 30-item checklist and flow diagram to report trial design, analysis, and interpretation fully and transparently. The site provides Checklist, Expanded checklist, Flow diagram, and the full Statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use CONSORT with Explanation and Elaboration
rubrics_metrics.description: We strongly recommend using the CONSORT Statement in conjunction with the 'Explanation and Elaboration' document.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Explanation and Elaboration document explains and illustrates the principles underlying CONSORT; consult it for examples, detailed rationale, and implementation guidance for each checklist item.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT checklist focus: design, analysis, interpretation
rubrics_metrics.description: The CONSORT checklist items focus on reporting how the trial was designed, analysed, and interpreted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When completing the CONSORT checklist, ensure items clearly describe trial design features, statistical analysis methods, and the interpretation of findings (including limitations and context).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT flow diagram: participant progress
rubrics_metrics.description: The flow diagram displays the progress of all participants through the trial.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the flow diagram to document numbers assessed for eligibility, randomized, receiving intended interventions, lost to follow-up, and analysed — providing a transparent account of participant flow.

rubrics_metrics.name: SEPTRE (SPIRIT Electronic Protocol Tool & Resource)
rubrics_metrics.description: SEPTRE is an online tool that allows you to create, register, and manage trial protocols.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use SEPTRE as a platform-aligned way to draft and register protocols following SPIRIT recommendations (click for more information and access).

rubrics_metrics.name: COBWEB (COnsort-Based WEB tool)
rubrics_metrics.description: COBWEB is an online writing aid tool that helps you to write, edit, share and export a randomised trial report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use COBWEB to support preparation of trial reports consistent with CONSORT items and flow diagram (click for more information and access).
